flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/PS/{form/PSForm,form/PSDetails,form/PSSummary,list/PSList,page/PS,page/PSView}.tsx, pages/NoticeSearch/hook/{ApplyOperationAction.tsx,useBatchOperation.ts}, context/OptionsContext.tsx, utils/{mapping,validation}/PS/PS.ts, utils/constant.ts. ocmsadminapi workflows/notice_creation/core/SuspensionProcessingController (staff-apply-suspension, staff-revive-suspension, staff-check-suspension-eligibility), core/helpers/{PermanentSuspensionHelper,SuspensionBaseHelper,SuspensionProcessingHelper,PermanentRevivalHelper,RevivalBaseHelper}, crud/ocmsizdb/suspendednotice/SuspendedNotice, api-authorization.properties (OCMS_APPLY_PS). ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not used by this staff PS flow
note: Status in stories.json is 'Fully paid'; there is no OCMS flow deck. Clicking 'Procced to PS' writes nothing to the DB yet: it only validates the form and opens the 'PS Confirmation' modal with generic text; the write happens after OK (story 18.9). A notice summary exists, but as a 'Summary' tab the officer must open manually, not shown automatically after the click. The server eligibility check (stage) runs earlier, when the notices are chosen from the search (useBatchOperation.ts:171-220). No maintenance ticket changes the verdict.
recommendation: Partial claim: the apply button, validation and holding the write until confirmation exist; the summary for confirmation is not shown automatically (separate Summary tab, generic-text modal)

steps.step: The officer presses the apply button (Proceed to PS) for the selected notices that already have a code and remarks
steps.detail: The 'Procced to PS' button (typo is in the label) is rendered only when notices exist (haveNotices, PSForm.tsx:342). Before the form opens, handlePS on the search page calls validatePS which POSTs to staff-check-suspension-eligibility; if any notice fails, the whole batch is blocked with an error modal and the form does not open (ApplyOperationAction.tsx:160-173). On the server, PS eligibility only checks the last processing stage (SuspensionProcessingHelper.java:283-295).

steps.step: OCMS validates the form input (suspension code mandatory) before continuing
steps.detail: onConfirmation runs validate() from the form context; if it fails, the alert 'Failed to PS the notice(s). Please check your form.' shows and focus moves to the faulty field (autoFocus). The only mandatory rule is suspension_code.

steps.step: Apply does not change notice data yet; changes are sent only after the officer confirms
steps.detail: After validation passes, onConfirmation only sets the confirmation modal state (PSForm.tsx:85-90). The staff-apply-suspension call is made in handleComModalOk -> onSubmit only after the officer presses OK (PSForm.tsx:260-263); the modal close button only hides the modal (PSForm.tsx:281).

steps.step: OCMS shows a summary of the notices for confirmation after apply is pressed
steps.detail: Pressing apply only opens the 'PS Confirmation' modal with the generic text 'Do you want to proceed to Permanently Suspend the notice(s)?' without the notice list, code or remarks (PSForm.tsx:85-90). The summary (notice list + code + remarks) lives in the 'Summary' tab of the same form (PSForm.tsx:370-393), but the officer must open that tab manually; there is no automatic tab switch. The summary content is judged in story 18.8.
